description: This file contains unit tests for the accel_enrichment module in a vehicle engine control system. It tests the behavior of the tpsAccelEnrichment class, specifically its getMaxDelta function, under simulated engine conditions.

classes.name: tpsAccelEnrichment
classes.description: A class responsible for managing throttle position based acceleration enrichment in the engine control system.

methods.name: getMaxDelta
methods.description: Returns the maximum delta value based on recent throttle position changes, used for enrichment calculations.

methods.name: onNewValue
methods.description: Sets a new throttle position value for the enrichment logic.

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Configures the length of the internal buffer or window for the enrichment calculations.
